name: Meegan Kepert
headline: Head of Delivery
about: A successful and well regarded project, program and product manager I draw on skills developed across a diverse range of sectors including finance, banking, education and utilities. Comfortable communicating across IT, Business and Senior Management I am often pivotal to the implementation of major transformational change and strategic initiatives.

experiences.position: Global Head of Product Strategy and Projects
experiences.description:
etika was founded in 2012 by a group of tech entrepreneurs that wanted to make fairer finance accessible to more people globally.

etika offers affordable finance, tailored to the needs of customers, anywhere and anytime.

Ensured the operational readiness across Technology to support IAG’s first release in a major digital Policy Transformation Program, representing the culmination of over 600 people's effort across 19 months.

Significantly uplifted the culture, achieved a 76 point increase in employee advocacy and successfully unified multiple trans-Tasman and offshore teams to create a well regarded and resilient Outbound Customer Communications Service Offering. 

Increased cloud adoption, successfully negotiating extensive internal and external regulator approval to transition three systems to the cloud, including a material workload of high inherent risk. Practices and templates I refined increased the process efficiency for subsequent transitions.

Transitioned the Claims platform through the introduction of partnering with an offshore software development centre, to over double the capacity of the platform. Constituting at the time over 50% of the entire Group Technology project capacity, this ensured the successful delivery of significant concurrent strategic programs across the company.

Responsible for the coordination and delivery of all project work for the Claims and Supply Chain Platform. As practice lead for both the Project & Iteration Management Practice and the Business Analysis Practice on the platform and with line management of 40+ permanent, contractor and partner PMs, IMs and BAs, I continually improved practices in these areas and optimised resourcing across a diverse portfolio of demand.

experiences.position: Product and Project Manager Team Lead
experiences.description:
Established the role of Product Manager within the Claims and Supply Chain Platform, redesigning the delivery approach to increase throughput. 

Concurrently delivered four major program initiatives plus smaller enhancements through the coordination of between five and seven functionally themed agile sticky teams. These deliverables were all on time or ahead of schedule, delivered in a monthly cadence to facilitate the early release of business value and with extremely low defect rates.

Lead a team of ten Project Managers and Senior Project Managers across Business and Technology. Provided thought leadership on project management practices, coached and developed Project Managers and brokered issue resolution for escalated issues.

Established and led the Configuration Platform for the CGU Underwriting and Distribution Operating System. The tooling and practices established for the platform allowed controlled and efficient maintenance for over 400 unique product offerings in the Commercial Insurance space of IAG.

Project managed the development and implementation of an online channel for Professional Risk products and the development and introduction to CGU of an innovative User Interface Framework.

Achieved the fastest accreditation for a new product ever completed with the channel provider EBIX. Furthermore, by establishing with the provider that the technology and implementation made the interface agnostic to question set changes, it was possible to eliminate the need for future accreditation following question set updates or new product launches. This reduced time to market from over 4 weeks to a matter of days.

Project managed business critical system implementations and process improvements, such as the seamless implementation of a new Human Resources Information System, servicing over 7,500 staff.

Managed the University’s response to the introduction of contestability in the Vocational Education sector. Successfully lobbied Government to amend their policy and timelines, implemented major system modifications and managed business change ensuring continued access to $85 million in annual revenue. Was awarded both the Pro-Vice Chancellor’s “Individual Initiative" Award” and “Team Service Delivery Award” in recognition of this.

Responsible for the evaluation and recommendation of strategic proposals associated with new technologies and managed the development and implementation of commercially viable projects.

Established relationships with a leading Spanish Banking Consortium to investigate a potential joint venture. This transformed the way RBS viewed their relationship from competitor to partner and the resultant product received European wide accolades with a VISA OSCARD award.

experiences.position: IT Project Manager and Oracle Database System Designer
experiences.description:
Matrix managed 25 IT staff and mentored junior Project Managers to increase productivity. Coordinated global initiatives and managed $5 million worth of annual programs, whilst directly managing key high risk projects like the well coordinated and ahead of schedule Australian IT involvement in the $3.3 billion acquisition of a competitor’s power generation assets. 

Designed, established and staffed a communications and technology room for the 2006 International Power Global Forum. Commended by the CEO for enabling over 200 key employees from around the world to function as if they were at home and setting a new benchmark for the IT provision and presence at future forums.

Designed and managed the $2 million in house Oracle PL/SQL coding development of a middle office risk management and reporting system for bilateral agreements worth $1.2 billion.

Actively managed the company’s relationships with over 50 counterparties, for financial trading purposes, to successfully hedge $400 million in yearly electricity output in a highly illiquid trading environment.
